title: clerodendrum squamatum var. bethuneanum
intro: Clerodendrum squamatum var. bethuneanum, commonly known as the Bethune's glory bower, is a plant species in the family Lamiaceae. It is a climbing plant native to tropical Asia and is traditionally used in folk medicine. The health benefits of Bethune's glory bower include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, clerodane diterpenes, and flavonoids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including sedative, antispasmodic, and antimicrobial effects.
